description: JVM semantic slice conformance (ISSUE-0092). JVM-only fixtures for the first semantic slice after the ISSUE-0091 skeleton: int/number arithmetic, string concatenation and template literals (checker-typed string interpolations), boolean comparisons, local mutation, if/else, while loops (counting, nested, body-scoped shadowing, while-false bodies that never run, per-iteration re-evaluation of conditions with hoisted null-typed side effects), and frontend compile-error gates (E3007 non-boolean while condition, E3016 non-string interpolation) rejected before any backend runs. Every runtime fixture passes through the real DEAL frontend, real JvmBackend codegen, a javac subprocess, and a java subprocess executing the emitted artifact (the harness fails a fixture whose codegen or JVM execution is bypassed).

tests.name: jvm-slice-int-arithmetic
tests.description: Checked int arithmetic (+ - * / % **) chains through locals to 41

tests.name: jvm-slice-number-arithmetic
tests.description: Number arithmetic with mixed int/number widening and floored % (-7.0 % 3.0 = 2.0) computes 5.0

tests.name: jvm-slice-string-concat
tests.description: String concatenation builds 'jvm-deal' from two locals

tests.name: jvm-slice-template-basic
tests.description: A template literal with string-typed interpolations lowers to concatenation

tests.name: jvm-slice-template-plain-and-parts
tests.description: Plain templates, empty literal parts (elided), and empty interpolation parts (kept, they are expressions)

tests.name: jvm-slice-boolean-comparisons
tests.description: int/string comparisons, equality, negation, and &&/|| compose to true

tests.name: jvm-slice-local-mutation
tests.description: Local reassignment plus inner-block shadowing compute 111

tests.name: jvm-slice-if-else
tests.description: if/else-if/else branches classify three values and gate the result

tests.name: jvm-slice-while-sum
tests.description: A while loop with local mutation accumulates 1..10 = 55

tests.name: jvm-slice-while-nested-shadow
tests.description: Nested while loops with body-scoped locals and shadowing compute the triangular sums 1+3+6+10 = 20

tests.name: jvm-slice-while-false-skipped
tests.description: while (false) never runs its body — the result stays 1

tests.name: jvm-slice-while-hoisted-condition
tests.description: A while condition with a side-effecting null-typed call re-evaluates per iteration (tick prints; the loop counts to 3)

tests.name: jvm-slice-frontend-reject-while-cond
tests.description: A non-boolean while condition is rejected by the frontend (E3007) before any backend runs

tests.name: jvm-slice-frontend-reject-template-type
